_about: Credential Engine's top 50 rows that kb/it_ai_credential_catalog.json marks 'not in MAP', each checked by hand against the reference's titles and issuers (kb/exhibits_adoption.json, kb/credentials.json). The catalog's join missed 11 that MAP holds. in_map: the reference holds it, so the Credential Catalog does not list it for review. related: MAP holds another credential from the same issuer, named beside it. not_in_map: no reference title names it. kb/_build_adopt_page.py lists related and not_in_map rows under Worth a faculty review; a top-50 row with no verdict here is not listed until it is checked.
_checked_by: SkyElderberry (CER redesign side session), 2026-10-31, reading each candidate title with its issuer; proceeded on the recommendation, and a curator may change any verdict.
